exceptions.subject: ubuntu-24.04
exceptions.risk_reason: GitHub-hosted runner images are not exposed as digest-addressable artifacts; the fixed OS label still receives image updates.
exceptions.mitigation: The OS family is fixed, every external action and OCI image is digest-bound, Node is exact, and release jobs fail closed on their required tool versions. Re-reviewed the actual CI image 20261012.334.1 on 2026-10-25 against official immutable runner documentation (OS 24.04.5 LTS, kernel 6.17.0-1022-azure, PostgreSQL client 16.15). Seven-day renewal only; see docs/ci-runner-review-20261025.md.
